  [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace G] [inst_2 : MeasurableSingletonClass G] (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → G)
  [inst_3 : FiniteRange X] (hX : ¬AEMeasurable X μ) : (Measure.map X μ) (↑(toFinset X))ᶜ = 0 := by
  simp [hX]

theorem FiniteRange.extracted_1.{u_2, u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace G] [inst_2 : MeasurableSingletonClass G] (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → G)
  [inst_3 : FiniteRange X] (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) : (Measure.map X μ) (↑(toFinset X))ᶜ = 0 := by
  Measure.map_apply₀ hX]
      convert measure_empty (μ := μ)
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.preimage_compl, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Finset.mem_coe, mem_iff,
        exists_apply_eq_apply, not_true_eq_false, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      simp only [NullMeasurableSet.compl_iff]
      refine MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet ?_
      measurability
dependencies.name: extracted_split_FiniteRange.null_of_compl_1
